title: Viral Sample Titration
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Gather labware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons 200 µL Filter Tips, P300 Multichannel GEN2 pipette, Corning 96‑Well Round Bottom 1 mL dilution plates, Corning 96‑well Flat Clear Bottom Black Polystyrene TC‑treated analysis microplates, NEST 96‑Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full Skirt for samples, and a NEST 1‑Well 195 mL reservoir for media.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload the protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, open the Protocol tab and upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the tip rack, dilution plates, analysis dish, sample plate, and media reservoir on the deck positions indicated by the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate the tip rack, all plates, the reservoir, and the P300 Multichannel GEN2 pipette using calibration tips.

steps.title: Add media to dilution plates
steps.instruction: Using the multichannel pipette with Opentrons 200 µL filter tips, transfer the appropriate volume of media from the 195 mL reservoir to each column of the dilution plates, covering up to 12 columns. Perform the transfers on a per‑column basis.

steps.title: Transfer sample from first column
steps.instruction: Using the multichannel pipette, transfer the sample from the first column (well A1) of the NEST 96‑Well 100 µL PCR Full Skirt plate into the corresponding well of the dilution plate.

steps.title: Perform serial dilutions with column skips
steps.instruction: Continue the serial dilution across the dilution plates, skipping three columns for each successive dilution as described (i.e., after each dilution step, leave three columns empty before the next dilution).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the Opentrons App to execute the programmed steps.
